implementation: Admit only immutable original sources with complete independent preset profile, matched typed body and named target. Keep immutable source evidence unchanged. Normalize unambiguous named-only, vector-only and coherent dual edits; refuse conflicting dual edits.

Use the existing production canonical preset writer in a private vector sink. Put its typed scalar values into independently profiled original primary slots by code occurrence. Retain derived RapidRT predefined placement and non-body common/application/XDATA carriers, then use existing raw handle transport and actual staged field inspection.

Use lossless encoding for newly synthesized preset body text, including literal CIF/MIF prefixes, Unicode and caret text, even when the remainder of the export uses compatible carrier policy. Keep untouched raw replay and public text-policy behavior outside the new route.

Freeze live typed state and original raw carrier before callbacks; recheck before preset writes, at staged inspection and finalization. Require actual edited output equality and dictionary proof before publication. Refuse callback mutations, unsupported common metadata edits, renaming and schema/optional-presence changes.

Cap plan rows at100000 and logical allowance at64MiB, including typed/raw copies, nodes and pessimistic text expansion. This is not allocator-capacity, RSS or controlled performance proof. Perform whole-plan scans once per phase instead of once per preset.
Keep direct dxfRW consumers without a facade plan and ordinary no-preset 2D streaming compatible. Preserve the immutable source/support ledger and external gates.

controls.finalizationFaultScope: Injection only around the real frozen-state helper in the actual finalization callback; failed attempts preserve destination sentinel.

controls.existingSourceControls: Replace five former blanket body-edit refusals with genuinely unrepresentable edits, retaining100 destination rollbacks and all previous counter totals.

Bound all named aliases before normalization, add four vector/named boundary/refusal/readback controls, retain the pre-correction builds/archives separately, and rebuild/repackage final inputs before runtime qualification.

The new metadata test initially expected all arbitrary app handles literal. Observed existing raw policy maps translated330/340/360 while keeping application5 literal; correct the expectation, keep this transport scope distinct from independent native semantic role proof.
